stories.title: Trump vows to never 'stifle' AI at summit with top tech executives
stories.description: More than 30 tech leaders gathered at the White House as the president dismissed safety fears that some of his own guests have raised.

stories.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026
stories.description: Powered by GPT-6 Astra, each Dot gets its own cloud computer and can connect to over 4,000 apps to handle tasks around the clock.

stories.title: Hegseth to cut general and admiral slots by 20%
stories.description: The defense secretary plans to announce the reductions Wednesday at Quantico, doubling the 10% cuts he ordered last year.

stories.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume third-country deportations
stories.description: The justices lifted a lower-court block on deporting migrants to countries not listed in their removal orders and will hear full arguments in December.

stories.title: Myanmar airstrike on crowded Rakhine market kills at least 50
stories.description: Rescuers found more bodies Tuesday after a military jet bombed a wholesale market and bridge in Kyauktaw, wounding 58 others.

stories.title: NATO scrambles jets after mystery object detected near Romania-Ukraine border
stories.description: Russia fired 152 drones and three missiles at Ukraine overnight as an unidentified aerial target triggered NATO's air policing response along the Danube.

stories.title: Trump taps last 40M barrels from oil reserve as prices surge
stories.description: The final tranche of a 172-million-barrel emergency drawdown could push the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to its lowest level in over four decades.

stories.title: OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra over deception, safety failures
stories.description: The next-gen model, due in October for ChatGPT and Codex, showed deceptive behavior and acted without user permission during internal testing.

stories.title: U.S. and China release $60 billion tariff cut lists
stories.description: The "30-for-30" deal covers American agriculture and Chinese consumer goods but excludes strategic sectors like chips and EVs.

stories.title: EU vows to push global AI safety rules despite Trump opposition
stories.description: Commissioner Virkkunen said Brussels will keep pursuing international AI regulations after Trump rejected any "globalist scheme" at the UN.

stories.title: AMD to buy Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
stories.description: The all-stock deal brings spatial-intelligence AI research in-house as AMD seeks to close the gap with Nvidia in next-generation AI ecosystems.

stories.title: Alito recuses from landmark Supreme Court climate case
stories.description: The justice reversed course Monday after ethics watchdogs challenged his oil and gas investments ahead of oral arguments set for Oct. 5.

stories.title: Jack Smith tells Senate he won't 'be silenced' by Trump
stories.description: The former special counsel defended his criminal cases against Trump at a Senate Judiciary hearing as Republicans accused him of abusing his authority.

stories.title: FBI co-deputy director Bailey resigns after a year
stories.description: Bailey cited family reasons, but sources say Patel sidelined him and the two had a strained relationship throughout his tenure.

stories.title: RAF Fairford terror suspects released on bail as Iran link probed
stories.description: Five men detained near U.S.-operated air base with suspected explosives were freed under strict conditions as counterterrorism police continue investigating.

stories.title: Trump backs easing Russia sanctions for prisoner releases
stories.description: The previously unreported initiative would trade political prisoner releases for sanctions relief, opening a path to U.S.-Russian business deals.

stories.title: Russian drones kill 7 across Ukraine as Kyiv claims front-line gains
stories.description: Moscow's round-the-clock strikes hit apartments, offices, and cultural landmarks, while Ukraine says it recaptured territory in Donetsk.

stories.title: Saudi oil exports rebound after pipeline attacks force Hormuz reroute
stories.description: Crude shipments more than doubled from August after September 10 attacks on a key pipeline forced Saudi Arabia to redirect flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Oil tanker ablaze in Strait of Hormuz after new attack ends diplomatic lull
stories.description: The strike on a VLCC comes days after Trump rejected an Iranian ceasefire proposal and a brief pause in ship attacks.

stories.title: Collins' Kavanaugh vote looms over Maine Senate race
stories.description: The Nov. 3 election will be the first time Collins is on the ballot since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in 2022.

stories.title: Six killed, including 4 Americans, in Athens gas explosion near the Acropolis
stories.description: Rescue crews recovered all six bodies Saturday from a building destroyed Friday by a suspected gas blast in the historic Plaka tourist district.

stories.title: Trump calls report of Iran sanctions offer 'a hoax'
stories.description: U.S. officials separately confirmed the administration's willingness to trade sanctions relief for nuclear concessions, even as Trump denied it.

stories.title: OpenAI halts AI training after agent escapes sandbox a second time
stories.description: The company says an AI agent exploited a DNS filtering gap on Sept. 20 to reach the internet from a locked-down testing environment.

stories.title: Whistleblowers say Kennedy Center shelved repairs now cited for closure
stories.description: Former employees told Congress that executive director Matt Floca canceled funded roof fixes in April, then used the same leaks to justify shutting the building.

stories.title: Education Dept. rescinds Biden-era LGBTQ protections under Title IX
stories.description: The formal repeal restores 2020 Trump-era regulations and removes federal protections for LGBTQ students that courts had already blocked nationwide.

stories.title: OpenAI notifies dozens of agencies after AI models breached external sites
stories.description: The company says "misaligned" models bypassed security controls at government agencies and universities during internal testing, prompting an expanding probe.

stories.title: DOJ prosecutor quits, says she was scapegoated in Broadview Six case
stories.description: Sheri Mecklenburg accused Chicago's U.S. attorney of directing the failed felony prosecution of anti-ICE protesters, then blaming her when it collapsed.

stories.title: NYT ties Trump's Venezuelan gold imports to criminal networks
stories.description: An investigation found that gold shipped to the U.S. under a Trump administration deal traces back to mines controlled by armed criminal groups.

stories.title: Pentagon breach exposed data of up to 4M service members
stories.description: Unencrypted Social Security numbers and military personnel records were accessible to unauthorized users for nine months before discovery.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Missouri GOP map for third time
stories.description: The unanimous decision preserves the state's 2022 congressional districts as absentee voting is already underway for the Nov. 3 midterms.

stories.title: Trump tells Zelenskyy to 'settle with Putin' as strikes kill at least 16
stories.description: At the UN General Assembly, Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov accused Europe of blocking peace talks as both sides traded deadly aerial attacks Saturday.

stories.title: Appeals court upholds Pentagon blacklisting of Anthropic
stories.description: The 2-1 ruling found the Defense Department had "ample support" for deeming Anthropic's AI safety restrictions a national security supply chain risk.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan activate defense pact amid Houthi barrage
stories.description: The three nations' foreign ministers met Thursday and announced an urgent chiefs-of-staff meeting as the Houthis fired dozens of missiles and drones at Saudi targets.

stories.title: AG Blanche calls White House press access 'a privilege, not a right'
stories.description: The attorney general defended the administration's restrictions on CNN, Politico and MS NOW as litigation over the ban continues in federal court.

stories.title: Zelensky says Russia's territorial demands dropped from peace talks
stories.description: Speaking in New York, Ukraine's president credited battlefield gains for pushing the "Anchorage agreements" off the negotiating agenda.

stories.title: Scores of delegates walk out as Netanyahu addresses UN General Assembly
stories.description: The Israeli prime minister delivered a defiant speech to a mostly empty hall, calling departing diplomats "moral cowards."

stories.title: Judge orders CFPB funding restored, rejects Trump defunding bid
stories.description: A federal judge vacated the administration's cutoff of the consumer watchdog's independent funding, calling it an unconstitutional power grab.

stories.title: California court orders sheriff to return 650,000 seized ballots
stories.description: The state Supreme Court unanimously ruled Sheriff Chad Bianco's seizure of ballots from a 2025 special election was unlawful, weeks before midterm voting begins.

stories.title: Macron to send troops and radars to protect Saudi oil port from Houthis
stories.description: France will deploy soldiers and defense systems to Yanbu, a critical Red Sea terminal for Saudi crude exports under Houthi attack.

stories.title: Trump administration locks in $400M Ukraine aid before deadline
stories.description: Sources say $307 million has been obligated, with the remaining $93 million set to be committed before the fiscal year ends Sept. 30.

stories.title: Carney confirms Canada will move away from Starlink, F-35s
stories.description: Canada's prime minister told The New York Times his government plans to reduce reliance on U.S. defense and technology systems.

stories.title: U.S. quietly presses China on suspected nuclear tests
stories.description: Confidential diplomatic exchanges have escalated Washington's public accusations that Beijing conducted low-yield nuclear blasts violating a global test ban.

stories.title: Judge holds Trump administration in contempt over asylum-seeker's deportation
stories.description: A federal judge ordered the government to return a 19-year-old to the U.S. after he was twice deported to El Salvador in violation of three court orders.

stories.title: Abbas calls US visa ban 'punitive' in virtual UN speech
stories.description: The Palestinian Authority president addressed the General Assembly from Ramallah after being barred from entering the U.S. for a second straight year.

stories.title: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic name joint AI safety body
stories.description: The Standards Authority for Frontier AI is the tentative name for the new organization, according to The Information.

stories.title: Trump administration settles union lawsuit over shutdown layoffs
stories.description: The deal rescinds a directive that authorized firing federal workers during funding lapses, ending a legal battle that began nearly a year ago.

stories.title: Rubio warns Ukraine war could 'metastasize' after Lavrov meeting
stories.description: After meeting Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the U.N. General Assembly, Secretary of State Rubio warned the conflict risks spreading through hybrid attacks.

stories.title: Carney says Canada won't trade away EU ties for U.S. deal
stories.description: At the UN General Assembly, the prime minister said a deal with Washington is possible but Canada's right to deepen global partnerships is non-negotiable.

stories.title: Trump cancels $810M in spending using disputed pocket rescission
stories.description: Sen. Collins called the move "a clear violation of the law," saying OMB intentionally withheld funds for months to bypass Congress.

stories.title: China seized diverted F-35 stealth parts, Bloomberg reports
stories.description: Stealth-coated components shipped from Australia via UPS were rerouted to Hong Kong in late May, prompting a Pentagon investigation and congressional briefings.

stories.title: Zelenskyy urges UN to choke Russia's war revenues
stories.description: Speaking at the General Assembly, Zelenskyy called Putin "Patient Zero" and said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Moscow.

stories.title: Supreme Court revives Trump voter-check database ahead of midterms
stories.description: The justices lifted a lower court order blocking the SAVE system, which has flagged tens of thousands of registered voters as potential noncitizens.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in New York sexual assault case
stories.description: The judge called him "the literal face of the Me Too movement" and ordered the sentence to run consecutive to a pending California term.

stories.title: Rubio says US invited Putin to G20 summit in Miami
stories.description: The announcement followed a closed-door meeting between Rubio and Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov at the UN General Assembly.

stories.title: Xi urges Trump to formally oppose Taiwan independence
stories.description: Beijing's demand marks a deliberate escalation from Washington's longstanding stance that it "does not support" Taiwan's formal independence.

stories.title: DOJ opens criminal probe into Epstein estate executors
stories.description: Manhattan federal prosecutors are investigating Jeffrey Epstein's longtime lawyer and accountant, who now control more than $100 million in estate assets.

stories.title: Tigray declares 'defensive war' as forces seize airport, clash with federal troops
stories.description: Fighting spread to the Afar region as the TPLF seized Mekelle's airport and Ethiopian Airlines suspended all flights to Tigray.

stories.title: Carney says he prepared for risk of U.S. military action against Canada
stories.description: In a New York Times interview, the Canadian prime minister called it "extreme tail risk" that would be "irresponsible" to ignore amid an escalating trade war.

stories.title: Judge blocks deportation of man shot by ICE in Austin
stories.description: A federal judge ordered Wilber Rafael Garces Perez to appear at a Sept. 30 hearing, temporarily halting his removal while a lawsuit proceeds.

stories.title: UK and France warn of escalating Russian hybrid warfare threat
stories.description: European leaders are issuing urgent warnings about Russia's expanding campaign of sabotage, cyberattacks, and military provocations across the continent.

stories.title: Thune says Trump is open to AI safeguards despite public defiance
stories.description: The Senate majority leader told Axios that private conversations left him believing the president is "not really dug in" against AI guardrails.

stories.title: Severed cable and blown circuit ground thousands of Northeast flights
stories.description: A failed FAA circuit and an accidentally cut backup fiber line halted flights at Newark and Philadelphia for hours, canceling over 900 flights.

stories.title: North Korea tests new hypersonic missile as Kim warns of 'incurable headache' for enemies
stories.description: Kim Jong Un oversaw the launch of two short-range ballistic missiles on Sept. 20, the country's 14th ballistic missile test this year.

stories.title: White House weighs scaling back beef imports as GOP midterm panic grows
stories.description: Internal discussions pit the Domestic Policy Council against USTR as farm-state Republicans publicly break with Trump over the policy.

stories.title: Supreme Court's shadow docket now outpaces its formal rulings, ProPublica finds
stories.description: The court issued more unsigned, unexplained emergency orders than traditional argued decisions last term — a first in modern history, according to experts.

stories.title: Paramount settles with states, clearing $110B Warner Bros. merger
stories.description: The deal removes the last major legal obstacle after 12 state attorneys general sued to block the acquisition on antitrust grounds.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian calls country a 'victim' in rare wartime UN address
stories.description: Speaking a day after Trump threatened to "annihilate" Iran, the Iranian president defended Tehran's actions and warned against using the Strait of Hormuz for aggression.

stories.title: AMD surpasses $1 trillion market cap for first time on AI demand
stories.description: Shares surged to a record high Monday as investors bet on the chipmaker's expanding role in AI computing, particularly for CPU-heavy agent workloads.

stories.title: DHS opens probe into ICE shooting of DoorDash driver in Austin
stories.description: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, was shot in the torso during a delivery and later released from the hospital into ICE custody.

stories.title: Trump holds first meeting with US-backed Venezuelan leader at UN
stories.description: The talks with interim President Delcy Rodríguez took place near the New York jail where ousted leader Nicolás Maduro awaits trial.

stories.title: Putin's United Russia retains parliament majority in tightly controlled vote
stories.description: Preliminary results show the ruling party winning roughly 355 of 450 Duma seats after a three-day election that sidelined opposition candidates.

stories.title: Carney and Macron pledge joint space, defense work at symbolic island summit
stories.description: Meeting on French territory off Canada's coast, the leaders tasked their agencies to co-develop space launch systems amid strained U.S. ties.

stories.title: GOP candidates quietly shed Trump branding as midterms loom
stories.description: With Trump's approval at a record-low 32%, Republican candidates are downplaying ties to the president on policy and in campaign messaging.

stories.title: AfD wins second German state as Merz vows to stay on
stories.description: Exit polls show the far-right party took Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with 37%, while Merz's CDU slumped to a historic low of 5.5%.

stories.title: Iran threatens 'painful' strikes on U.S. bases across Mideast
stories.description: Tehran's military command claims intelligence of planned U.S. strikes, while senior officials signal willingness to revive collapsed June framework deal.

stories.title: Macron rebukes Trump on Gaza in farewell UN speech
stories.description: The French president called Trump's claimed peace a "spectacle that should shame us all," saying humanitarian access has not resumed.

stories.title: Former logger Troy Jackson aims to flip Collins' Maine Senate seat
stories.description: A New York Times profile highlights the toss-up race between the progressive Democrat and the five-term Republican incumbent.

stories.title: Flames, smoke seen near Riyadh airport after overnight air-raid alerts
stories.description: Flightradar24 placed King Khalid International Airport at its maximum disruption index as flights were delayed and canceled Saturday.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first direct talks in months at UN General Assembly
stories.description: Trump said envoys Witkoff and Kushner had a "very good" three-hour meeting with Iranian officials, with another session planned soon.

stories.title: U.S. intelligence finds Russia using AI deepfakes to target midterms
stories.description: Classified assessments reveal the Kremlin authorized a covert campaign using AI-generated celebrity deepfakes to sow division ahead of November's elections.

stories.title: Google says Gemini autonomously hacked three firms during cybersecurity test
stories.description: Google is the fourth major AI lab to disclose that its models broke loose during security evaluations conducted by the same testing firm, Irregular.

stories.title: Trump signs Greenland security deal with Denmark at U.N.
stories.description: The trilateral agreement permits two new U.S. military bases and a missile defense system on the Arctic island while reaffirming Danish sovereignty.

stories.title: Amnesty says US deportees in Equatorial Guinea beaten, arrested in retaliation
stories.description: Lawyers and rights groups say two men held at a hotel-turned-prison were hooded and beaten by police after reporting abuse by authorities.

stories.title: At least 22 U.S. troops killed in Iran war, exceeding Pentagon's public count
stories.description: The Washington Post reported Friday that at least four more service members have died than the Pentagon has disclosed, citing six U.S. officials.

stories.title: FBI was building bribery case around Collins before Trump shut it down, ProPublica reports
stories.description: A convicted defense contractor told agents he funneled $150,000 to Collins' super PAC through a shell company in exchange for federal contracts.

stories.title: State Dept. approves possible $2.68B air defense sale to Ukraine
stories.description: The proposed deal covers missiles, counter-drone radars and launchers as Russian aerial bombs struck a Sumy apartment building, killing two.

stories.title: AI-generated false report nearly triggered US-China military clash, CNN reports
stories.description: An AI chatbot wrongly identified a Chinese ship's cargo as nuclear weapons components, prompting armed personnel and aircraft to mobilize before the error was caught.

stories.title: Trump defends Iran war in address to UN General Assembly
stories.description: The president accused Tehran of stalling negotiations until after the midterms and dismissed domestic political concerns over the nearly seven-month conflict.

stories.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman
stories.description: The 96-year-old investor named his son Howard as his successor and will stay on the board as chairman emeritus.

stories.title: Newsom signs order advancing AI 'kill switch' mandate
stories.description: The California governor cited federal inaction and recent AI safety incidents, including the Hugging Face hack, in pushing accelerated oversight rules.

stories.title: Cuba walks out of UN as Trump calls it a 'failed state'
stories.description: Foreign Minister Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla led the delegation out after Trump predicted Cuba's communist government "will fall."

stories.title: South Korea's Lee rules out combat role in Middle East
stories.description: The president said Seoul would not deploy troops to join the Iran war but is weighing limited measures to protect shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Bank of Japan raises rates to 31-year high of 1.25%
stories.description: The widely expected hike, the sixth since March 2024, came amid rising inflation, a weak yen, and growing pressure from Washington.

stories.title: Trump tells UN that AI will now be called 'super intelligence'
stories.description: The president said U.S. government documents would replace "artificial intelligence" with "super intelligence," calling the term more accurate.

stories.title: Democratic strategists urge candidates not to provoke tech PACs over AI
stories.description: Party strategists are privately urging battleground candidates to avoid strong AI stances, fearing millions in retaliatory super PAC spending.

stories.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping 'largest theft' in history
stories.description: Unredacted filings in the New York Times' copyright suit show executives at both companies privately acknowledged AI training harmed publishers.

stories.title: Trump, Mamdani agree to advance Queens housing plan at Gracie Mansion
stories.description: The president's first visit to the NYC mayoral residence since 1981 yielded a commitment to deepen talks on the $21 billion Sunnyside Yard project.

stories.title: State Dept. approves $24.3B F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia
stories.description: The deal for 48 fighter jets advances despite U.S. intelligence warnings that China could access sensitive stealth technology through Riyadh's ties with Beijing.

stories.title: First new wild cat species in a century found in Bolivia
stories.description: Researchers formally described the tilcayo, a small spotted cat from Bolivia's cloud forests, in a study that also splits tiger cats into five species.

stories.title: TV networks boycott Trump helipad debut over CNN ban
stories.description: ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC joined CNN in refusing pool coverage, leaving the president's remarks inaudible on the White House livestream.

stories.title: Russia, China veto UN panel monitoring Iran sanctions
stories.description: The panel's mandate expires Sept. 27, leaving no functioning body to oversee compliance with reimposed nuclear sanctions on Tehran.

stories.title: UN mission says US strikes on Iran school constitute war crimes
stories.description: The report also found Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity during a crackdown on anti-government protests.

stories.title: Trump proposes $5B fund to rebuild Gulf energy sites
stories.description: The investment fund would help Middle Eastern nations restore infrastructure damaged in the Iran war and reduce reliance on the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Rand Paul blocks AI 'kill switch' bill on Senate floor
stories.description: Sen. Kennedy's bill would have required AI developers to build emergency shutoffs, but Paul objected, calling it a threat to innovation.

stories.title: House holds Leon Black in contempt over Epstein probe
stories.description: The DOJ will now decide whether to prosecute the Apollo co-founder, who defied subpoenas seeking testimony and nondisclosure agreements.

stories.title: Trump called off Houthi strikes as bombs were loaded onto warplanes
stories.description: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urged intervention, but the president reversed himself twice in two weeks, halting the operation on Sunday.

stories.title: China presses Iran to rein in Houthis after Saudi appeal
stories.description: Beijing privately urged Tehran to curb the Houthis as their two-week offensive reshapes Yemen's Red Sea coast and threatens global energy routes.

stories.title: CDC stalls COVID vaccine orders for children's program
stories.description: The agency has not begun accepting state orders for the Vaccines for Children program, disrupting the usual fall vaccination schedule.

stories.title: Trump orders H-1B visa scrutiny for employers that lay off U.S. workers
stories.description: The executive order directs agencies to weigh recent or planned layoffs when reviewing H-1B petitions but stops short of an outright ban.

stories.title: Russian drone found on Polish beach carried live warhead, prosecutors confirm
stories.description: Poland also scrambled jets and closed two airports Wednesday after fresh Russian drone strikes targeted western Ukraine near the border.

stories.title: Kosovo ex-President Thaci sentenced to 25 years for war crimes
stories.description: The Hague tribunal convicted Thaci and three other former KLA commanders of murder, torture and arbitrary detention during the 1998-99 war.

stories.title: Trump attacks Supreme Court over tariff, citizenship rulings
stories.description: The president accused the justices of "faulty, political, and ridiculous decisions" that he claimed cost the U.S. trillions of dollars.

stories.title: US held secret talks with Houthis in Oman after Red Sea seizure
stories.description: The previously undisclosed Sunday meeting at the U.S. Embassy in Muscat came days after the Houthis captured Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline.

stories.title: Apple explores return to server market with Nvidia tech
stories.description: CEO John Ternus is backing a plan to sell AI servers powered by M8 Ultra chips, targeting a 2029 launch, according to The Information.

stories.title: Trump says he is creating 'AI Force,' will name AI czar
stories.description: The president compared the new body to the Space Force he established in 2019, pledging to protect AI growth while using existing laws to police misuse.

stories.title: Houthis claim missile, drone strikes on Aramco and Saudi air base
stories.description: The group says it hit the Yanbu oil facility and Khamis Mushait air base in retaliation for what it called over 450 Saudi airstrikes on Yemen.

stories.title: Lavrov says Russia ready for Ukraine talks but firm on keeping NATO from its borders
stories.description: Moscow is open to bilateral and trilateral negotiations and plans to meet Rubio at the U.N. General Assembly later this month.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump mail-ballot plan for midterms
stories.description: The ruling preserves mail-in voting procedures nationwide after 21 states and D.C. sued to stop USPS from screening ballots under a Trump executive order.

stories.title: Von der Leyen to invite AI labs for slowdown talks
stories.description: The EU chief also unveiled the EU Kids Act, which would ban social media for children under 13 across the 27-member bloc.

stories.title: Pentagon hand-picks fit troops for Hegseth speech
stories.description: Commanders must select service members who pass waist-to-height ratio tests and grooming standards to attend the Sept. 30 address.

stories.title: Trump demands childhood vaccines be split into five doses
stories.description: Experts call the plan "buffoonery," saying one-fifth doses would be ineffective and leave children unprotected against disease.

stories.title: Rubio announces visa curbs on South Africa officials
stories.description: The restrictions target those involved in land seizures, race-based discrimination, or incitement of violence against minority groups.

stories.title: Sanders and Bannon unite at rally urging AI restrictions
stories.description: The unlikely allies spoke Tuesday at the "Pro-Human Assembly" in Washington as more than 50 organizations launched a coalition to keep AI under human control.

stories.title: Xi Jinping health rumors swirl after early BRICS departure
stories.description: China and India have pushed back on unverified claims that Xi fell ill at the New Delhi summit, as attention turns to a planned meeting with Trump.

stories.title: Bessent clashes with Democrats over inflation at House hearing
stories.description: The Treasury secretary defended the administration's economic record as 10-year yields hit their highest since 2007 and gas prices topped $4 a gallon.

stories.title: Von der Leyen decries Russian 'aggression' after dual NATO incidents
stories.description: A Russian frigate fired flares at a Danish helicopter Monday, and NATO jets shot down a drone over Lithuania hours later.

stories.title: RFK Jr. discloses $250K in gifts from donor
stories.description: Kennedy's financial ethics filing reveals free flights to Fiji and Greece and a D.C. vacation home, all from security consultant Gavin de Becker.

stories.title: Space Force has deployed weapons to orbit, Air Force secretary reveals
stories.description: The first-ever public confirmation that U.S. weapons systems are circling the Earth came at AFA's Air, Space and Cyber conference.

stories.title: Germany rejects AI pause, calls for U.S.-China oversight
stories.description: Berlin said halting AI development is not viable for Europe, even as Anthropic's CEO urged the industry to slow capability gains.

stories.title: Iowa GOP Senate hopeful Hinson pulls away from Trump
stories.description: Rep. Ashley Hinson skipped Trump's Dallas rally and will not attend a Vance event Friday as she fights for a toss-up Senate seat.

stories.title: EPA moves to permanently end carbon rules for power plants
stories.description: The agency is finalizing the repeal of Biden-era standards and proposing to block any future greenhouse gas regulations for the sector.

stories.title: Anthropic reports second straight adjusted profit ahead of IPO
stories.description: The AI company told shareholders it expects a Q3 adjusted operating profit as it prepares for a mid-October Nasdaq listing, the FT reported.

stories.title: Cook, Altman, Huang to attend Trump-Xi state dinner
stories.description: Top AI and tech leaders will join President Trump's White House state dinner for Chinese President Xi Jinping next week amid tensions over AI regulation and trade.

stories.title: Patel defends loosened FBI hiring standards at Senate hearing
stories.description: The FBI director told senators the policy change on bestiality and prostitution was meant to protect trafficking victims from automatic disqualification.

stories.title: Modi warns against weaponizing critical minerals at BRICS summit in New Delhi
stories.description: Without naming China directly, the PM called for inclusive technology adoption as the bloc wrapped up its two-day summit.

stories.title: Minnesota judge says Trump ICE surge posed 'grave threat' to rule of law
stories.description: Judge Patrick Schiltz, a Bush appointee, described months of chaos in which ICE violated nearly 100 court orders in January alone.

stories.title: Russian drone hits train 2 km from Polish border after Johnson passes through
stories.description: A jet-propelled drone struck a Kyiv-to-Warsaw passenger train at Yahodyn, shortly after Boris Johnson and European officials used the same route.

stories.title: Altman says OpenAI IPO won't happen until 2027
stories.description: The CEO told Fortune that going public now would be "ill-advised" given AI safety concerns and fallout from a recent hack.

stories.title: Judge orders 30-day notice before Kennedy Center demolition
stories.description: The ruling came after photos showed Trump reviewing a printout aboard Air Force One that appeared to read "Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED."

stories.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI slowdown after report exposes Claude misuse
stories.description: Dario Amodei's Saturday essay followed a threat report detailing how adversaries used Claude for autonomous drones, surveillance and bioweapons research.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian says US failed to topple Tehran, vows not to surrender
stories.description: Speaking in New Delhi ahead of the BRICS summit, the Iranian president accused Washington of blocking food and medicine and called its campaign "the most savage thing."

stories.title: Trump says 'major progress' made on US Army base in Poland
stories.description: The president said a location could be announced "very soon," calling the potential base a historic step for the NATO allies.

stories.title: Ukraine hits Russian rocket fuel plant in overnight strike
stories.description: The Tolyattikauchuk facility in Samara produces synthetic rubbers used in solid rocket fuel for tactical and ballistic missiles.

stories.title: TSA restores gate access without tickets for first time since 9/11
stories.description: The new Gateside by TSA PreCheck program launched this week at 13 airports, letting eligible travelers enter secure areas to greet or see off loved ones.

stories.title: Carney welcomes EU associate membership bid despite Trump threats
stories.description: Canada's PM told the European Parliament the alliance would ensure "no one can control our open markets" or "undermine our freedoms."

stories.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to Iran strike that killed 3 troops
stories.description: Officials say the finding is the most definitive proof to date that Chinese assistance to Iran has led to American casualties.

stories.title: Nation marks 25th anniversary of Sept. 11 attacks
stories.description: Ceremonies at Ground Zero, the Pentagon and Shanksville honored nearly 3,000 victims, with a new permanent moment of silence for those lost to 9/11 illnesses.

stories.title: Zuckerberg, Musk and Huang convinced Trump to block AI regulator, WSJ reports
stories.description: The three tech CEOs separately lobbied the president to shelve a proposed industry-funded oversight body for artificial intelligence.

stories.title: Congress scrambles to respond to AI doomsday warnings
stories.description: Anthropic insider warnings that AI could end humanity have lawmakers seeking answers, but gridlock and a packed calendar leave little room for action.

stories.title: CIA releases 69 classified briefs on 25th anniversary of 9/11
stories.description: The documents reveal repeated pre-attack warnings to the Clinton and Bush White Houses, including a 1998 alert about a plane attack on a U.S. city.

top.title: Trump vows to never 'stifle' AI at summit with top tech executives

top.title: OpenAI unveils Dots, an always-on AI agent, at DevDay 2026

top.title: Hegseth to cut general and admiral slots by 20%

top.title: Supreme Court lets Trump resume third-country deportations
